how_they_differentiate.answer: They claim to be the easiest free way to organize volunteer help (meals, rides, visits) for someone in need, by tapping the people who want to help but don't know how.

evidence.quote: We believe that people want to help, but often don't know how.

unique_value_proposition.answer: A free central place to organize meals, rides and other help from friends and family for someone in need.

evidence.quote: A central place to coordinate meals and help for friends & family.

retain_customers.answer: No contracts, tiers or limits are stated. What keeps a group active is its shared calendar of tasks, announcements emailed to the team, well wishes and a photo gallery.

relatives_joining.answer: Yes. The organizer creates a community and invites family, friends, neighbors and colleagues, who join with their own login; site admins assign roles and can make private groups (for example 'Family') that only they can add people to.

setup.answer: The organizer creates a community (care team), invites people and posts tasks; helpers join an existing team. Web plus an iPhone/Android app (iPhone app needs iOS 15.1 or later).
